contents.reason: This page proves only the convex expectation inequality. It does not claim a tail bound, because the separate exceptional-event, measurability and integrability premises in these tail results are not part of the page's theorem.

Theorem 8.1 inequality (2): finite-r logarithmic covering bound for VC classes of sets, with complete proof

contents.reason: The required finite-r logarithmic inequality is the proved inequality (2). Inequality (3) is sharper but is not proved in the inspected treatment, so the page does not rely on it or present it as established.

contents.name: Theorem 8.2: envelope-weighted transfer from VC set coverings to function-class coverings
contents.reason: The transfer idea is retained, but its continuous uniform auxiliary coordinate would use the repository's Countable-Choice-qualified Lebesgue interval supplier. The local proof replaces that coordinate by a finite trapezoidal grid and proves its discrepancy directly.
